lines.text: مساعد باشد در افلاك واگر از تثلیث و تسدیس و تربیع باشد دلالت کند بر اجتار کارها
lines.en: it is favorable in the spheres. And if it is from a trine, sextile, or square, it indicates the undertaking of affairs,

lines.text: و وقوع فتنه و بهتان در میان مردم و بیماری سودائی و اسقاط اجنه و بر فتنه و فساد و
lines.en: and the occurrence of sedition and calumny among the people, and melancholic illness, and the miscarriage of fetuses, and upon sedition and corruption, and

lines.text: وقت و مخالفت سلاطین با رعیت و بهتان جستن بر یکدیگر و اگر از تربیع ایمن بود
lines.en: of the time, and the opposition of sultans to the subjects, and seeking slander against one another. And if it is from a square, it is safe,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر خوابهای فرحناك و بیماریهای سرد و درد والم و تباهی حال محبوسان
lines.en: it indicates joyful dreams, and cold illnesses, and pain and suffering, and the ruin of the condition of prisoners,

lines.text: و ذل و محنت و آفت از جانب ملوك و درماندن کارها و اگر از تربیع ایسر بود دلالت
lines.en: and abasement and affliction and calamity from the side of kings, and the stalling of affairs. And if it is from a left square, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر خصومت و منازعت میان ملوك و رعیت و جور و ستم و دشواری مهمات عامه
lines.en: enmity and dispute between kings and subjects, and tyranny and oppression, and the difficulty of general important matters,

lines.text: و سختی و بی طاقتی و بیماری تشویش و اگر مقابله بود دلالت کند بر منازعت و مخاصمه
lines.en: and hardship and powerlessness, and illness of anxiety. And if it is an opposition, it indicates dispute and enmity

lines.text: در میان رعایا و عظما و بی اتفاقی و رفتن عوام بتظلم نزد پادشاهان و اعیان دولت
lines.en: among the subjects and the great ones, and lack of agreement, and the commoners going to complain of injustice to the kings and the notables of the state,

lines.text: و غمناکی دلها و جور و ستم و بیماری و سختی در مردم (اتصال قمر بعد از انصراف از شمس)
lines.en: and the sadness of hearts, and tyranny and oppression, and illness and hardship among the people. (The conjunction of the Moon after separating from the Sun)

lines.text: اگر مقارن باشد دلالت کند بر صلاح حال عامه و رغبت کردن بکارهای خیر و قوة
lines.en: If it is a conjunction, it indicates the goodness of the condition of the common people, and the inclination to do good deeds, and the strength of

lines.text: حال شرفا و فقها و زهاد و رعایت حال شریعت و طلب صحبت اهل علم و خوبی حال
lines.en: the condition of the nobles and jurists and ascetics, and the observance of the condition of the Sharia, and seeking the company of the people of knowledge, and the goodness of the condition of

lines.text: بازرگانان و مسافران و اگر تثلیث یا تسدیس باشد دلالت کند بر قوة حال وزرا و
lines.en: merchants and travelers. And if it is a trine or sextile, it indicates the strength of the condition of viziers and

lines.text: کبار و صدور و اهل عزت و شرف و موافقت علما و برامدن حاجات و مهمات مردم
lines.en: the great ones and the eminent ones and the people of honor and nobility, and the agreement of the scholars, and the fulfillment of the needs and important matters of the people,

lines.text: و مهربانی و نیکی در میان خلایق و کمی فساد و ایمنی راهها و متابعت مردم راه حق را
lines.en: and kindness and goodness among the creatures, and the decrease of corruption, and the safety of the roads, and the people following the path of truth.

lines.text: و اگر از تربیع ایمن بود دلالت کند بر استحکام شرط در دین و موافقت عامه با اشراف
lines.en: And if it is safe from a square, it indicates the firmness of the condition in religion, and the agreement of the common people with the nobles

lines.text: و علما و برامدن حاجتهای مردم بدشواری و اگر تربیع ایسر بود دلالت کند بر قوة
lines.en: and scholars, and the fulfillment of the needs of the people with difficulty. And if it is a left square, it indicates the strength of

lines.text: حال قضاة و اهل شرف و خوشی حال عامه و خوبی معیشت خلایق سیما تجار و خشونت
lines.en: the condition of judges and the people of nobility, and the happiness of the condition of the commoners, and the goodness of the livelihood of the creatures, especially merchants, and the harshness of

lines.text: بزرگان و بیرون امدن بر اهل علم و اگر از مقابله باشد دلالت کند بر اجتناب عامه
lines.en: the great ones, and coming out against the people of knowledge. And if it is from an opposition, it indicates the avoidance of the commoners

lines.text: از اشراف و عظما و آخر باختلاف منجر شود (تنبیه) معلم اول ارسطاطالیس در فصل
lines.en: from the nobles and the great ones, and in the end it leads to disagreement. (Warning) The First Teacher, Aristotle, in the chapter

lines.text: شصت و دوم از کتاب خود فرموده که احوال اسفار از طوالع ارباع سال معلوم میشود
lines.en: sixty-two of his book has stated that the conditions of journeys are known from the ascendants of the quarters of the year,

lines.text: و بعد از ان اتصال قمر مهر اجتماع پس چون قمر از محل اجتماع روزی منصرف شده
lines.en: and after that the application of the Moon to the Sun of the conjunction. So when the Moon separates from the place of the conjunction of a day,

lines.text: متصل باحد العلویین گردد اگر ان علوی در حظی از حظوظ خود بود یا در موضعی
lines.en: and applies to one of the superior planets, if that superior planet is in one of its dignities, or in a place

lines.text: که در انموضع قوی شود مثل انکه بیت اقبال یا ربع متصل با بیت فرح خود بود یا صاعد
lines.en: where it becomes strong in that place, such as the house of prosperity or a quarter connected to its house of joy, or ascending

summary.headline: Lunar Separation and Subsequent Aspects
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon’s aspects after separating from the Sun, associating trines, sextiles, squares, left squares, and oppositions with public unrest, illness, oppression, prosperity, religious conditions, commerce, travel, and relations among rulers, subjects, nobles, and scholars. Aristotle is cited on judging journeys from the ascendants of the year’s quarters and the Moon’s subsequent application to superior planets in their dignities.
